Recorded claim:
Replying with a selected plain-text range must preserve its original line breaks and avoid inserted hard-wrap newlines. The editor still wraps visually with moz-quote-pre and pre-wrap. Entry316 tests exact text, absence of unwanted HTML, computed style and multiple transfer encodings. Current extraction moved to MailMessageChild.getSelectionForQuoting and retains OutputRaw|SkipInvisibleContent. Test content and presentation as separate contracts.
